products.name: AI Landing Zone & Governance (Private Networking, Content Safety, Cost) — Commercial
products.short_description: Build the governed foundation every AI workload lands in — private networking, policy guardrails, content safety, identity, and cost controls.
products.description:
Build the governed foundation every AI workload lands in — private networking, policy guardrails, content safety, identity, and cost controls.

Scaling AI without a landing zone means every team re-solves networking, identity, safety, and cost — inconsistently and insecurely. This solution deploys an AI landing zone: a hub/spoke network with private endpoints for AI services, Azure Policy guardrails (allowed models/regions, private-only, content-safety-on), managed identity and RBAC, content-safety defaults, and cost management with budgets and quotas.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Python, IaC & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Hub/spoke network with private endpoints for AI services (as code)
  • Azure Policy guardrails — allowed models/regions, private-only, tagging
  • Identity & RBAC baseline and Key Vault for secrets
  • Content-safety and responsible-AI defaults applied at the platform
  • Cost management — budgets, quotas, and usage dashboards

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A governed AI landing zone every workload deploys into — consistent networking, identity, safety, and cost guardrails, not per-team reinvention.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 3 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AILZ-Discovery.ps1 — inventory current Azure state before building the AI landing zone (read-only)
    • AILZ-Report.ps1 — posture + cost snapshot for the AI landing zone (read-only)
    • AILZ-Validate.ps1 — run the AI landing-zone pass/fail gates (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
